skills.skill: Evaluate repeated multiplication written in exponential notation

misconceptions.pattern: Multiplies the base by the exponent instead of multiplying the base by itself (answers 2^5 as 10 rather than 32).

strategies.intent: Write the power out as repeated multiplication (2^5 = 2×2×2×2×2), then multiply step by step. The exponent counts how many times the base appears, not what to multiply it by.
